name: Cursed Digging Machine
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) twice on the cart to dismantle core connected pieces, or DC 20 Nature check or DC 20 Occultism check (trained) check to temporarily disable the jinkins' curse and render the machine inert for an hour
routine: (3 actions) The digging machine spends an action to move 20 feet toward the nearest creature. If it starts next to a creature, it moves 20 feet toward the next closest creature. It then makes two slashing shovels attacks against any creature within 10 feet.

items.name: Crash and Slash
items.text:
Trigger A creature comes within 30 feet of the digging machine

---
Effect The digging machine rattles to life and rolls toward the triggering creature. It moves 30 feet toward the creature, attacking every creature within 10 feet with slashing shovels. The machine then rolls initiative.

text: A large, wheeled cart with a multi-sectioned pole in the middle. Each section of pole has several shovels sticking out of it like makeshift arms.
